content_sections.text: Registration Deadline vs Application Deadline: Candidates must complete registration or re-registration by 29 November 2026. After registering, they must fill out and submit the application form by 5 December 2026. Merely obtaining a registration number does not constitute a completed application.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Vacancy 2026 - 238 Posts
content_sections.text: District-Wise Vacancy Note: Mayurbhanj has the highest number of vacancies with 18, followed by Sundargarh with 16 and Ganjam with 15. The vacancies are district cadre positions, and candidates must submit their district preferences according to the commission's instructions. The women-earmarked figures are included within the 238 advertised vacancies and must not be added separately. Special-category reservations for eligible Ex-Servicemen, Sportspersons and Persons with Disabilities are also provided in Annexure-I. District preference does not guarantee appointment to a particular district. Final allotment depends on examination merit, category reservation, district vacancies and the applicable allocation procedure.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission has issued the for recruitment of 238 District Cadre Group-C Ophthalmic Officers. The detailed 15-page notification contains district-wise vacancies, reservation, educational qualifications, professional registration, age limit, salary, examination fee, written-test pattern, negative marking, merit rules and online application instructions. Official Detailed Notification:

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed +2 Science or its equivalent and successfully completed the prescribed two-year certified ophthalmic training programme. Valid registration with the Ophthalmic Officers' Council in Odisha is also mandatory. Yes. The notification requires a two-year certified Ophthalmic Assistant Training Course or certified Ophthalmic Surgical Assistant Course from a Government or Government-recognized institution of Odisha. Candidates who have passed +2 Science but do not possess the prescribed professional training qualification are not eligible. Yes. Candidates must have registered their names with the Ophthalmic Officers' Council in Odisha and possess a valid registration certificate when submitting the online application form. The registration certificate must be uploaded as required by the application portal. Candidates should not assume they can obtain the mandatory registration only after the recruitment examination. Candidates must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must satisfy at least one of the prescribed language-related qualification conditions. Passed the Middle School Examination with Odia as a language subject. Passed Matriculation or equivalent with Odia as the medium of examination in non-language subjects. Passed Odia as a language subject in the final examination of Class VII from a recognized institution. Passed the prescribed Odia language test at M.E. School standard conducted by the competent authority. Important: Knowing conversational Odia alone does not replace the required supporting language qualification or certificate. Candidates must be Indian citizens, possess good character and satisfy the marriage-related and other eligibility conditions prescribed under the relevant Odisha Government service rules.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Ophthalmic Officers will be appointed under Pay Matrix Level-7, Cell-01 , with the notified pay scale of Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100 . Salary Clarification: Rs. 25,500 is the notified entry basic pay, not guaranteed in-hand salary. Applicable allowances and deductions will be governed by the Odisha Government's prevailing service rules.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The examination fee is Rs. 500 for candidates other than those belonging to the notified exempted categories. Payment Mode: Online through Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card or UPI using the OSSSC payment gateway. The refund will be processed after the examination through the mechanism prescribed by the commission. Candidates should ensure that their bank account information is correct. Important: Candidates who do not attend the examination are not eligible for the refund. Failure to generate the required payment confirmation may also result in an incomplete application.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a 100-mark written examination , followed by the applicable document verification, screening and district-allotment process. Online Registration: Candidates register or re-register through the OSSSC website. Application Submission: Complete the recruitment-specific online application and pay the applicable fee. Written Examination: Appear for the 100-mark objective examination. Provisional Merit List: OSSSC prepares the relevant category-wise merit list from normalized or raw examination marks, as applicable. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates present original qualification, registration, category and other supporting certificates. District Allotment: Allocation is carried out according to merit, district vacancies, reservation and available preferences. Final Selection: Appointment is subject to successful verification and the recommendation and appointment procedures prescribed by the competent authorities.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination carries 100 marks and has a duration of two hours . It will be held in objective multiple-choice format through OMR or CBRE mode, as notified later. Meeting the minimum qualifying marks does not guarantee selection. Final shortlisting depends on examination performance, category-wise merit and the number of vacancies. If two or more candidates obtain equal written examination scores, the commission will apply the prescribed tie-breaking criteria. Higher percentage marks in the qualifying Ophthalmic Assistant or Ophthalmic Surgical Assistant examination. Higher age, where the professional qualification percentage is also equal. Higher Class 12 examination marks, if the tie continues. Other criteria determined by the commission where the preceding stages do not resolve the tie.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for the 238 Ophthalmic Officer vacancies through the official OSSSC website. Apply Online: OSSSC Recruitment Portal Registration Start Date: 5 November 2026. Registration Last Date: 29 November 2026. Final Application Last Date: 5 December 2026. Important: Candidates who have already registered for previous OSSSC recruitments must use the re-registration process for this recruitment. Registration or re-registration must be followed by the separate online application submission.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.osssc.gov.in . Open the Apply Online section. Select the Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026 application. If you are a new user, select New User Registration . If you have registered previously for OSSSC recruitment, select the prescribed Re-registration option. Carefully complete the registration or re-registration process. Keep the generated User ID and other login credentials secure. Log in to the OSSSC applicant portal. Open the Ophthalmic Officer online application form. Enter the requested personal, educational and professional qualification details. Provide the relevant Ophthalmic Officers' Council registration information. Enter the applicable category, reservation and other eligibility details. Complete the district preference section as provided in the application form. Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting documents. Pay the applicable examination fee through the online payment gateway. Check that the payment and application confirmation have been generated. Review the application carefully and complete final submission. Save the application details for future reference. Complete registration by 29 November 2026 and final application submission by 5 December 2026 . Important: Candidates must submit a complete online application. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. More than one application submitted by the same candidate may also result in cancellation of the candidature.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Documents Required 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep their original certificates and supporting records ready for application and subsequent verification. Class 10 certificate or equivalent age proof. +2 Science certificate and marksheet. Two-year certified Ophthalmic Assistant Training Course or Ophthalmic Surgical Assistant Course certificate. Valid registration certificate from the Ophthalmic Officers' Council, Odisha. Odia language qualification certificate or prescribed language-test evidence. Valid photo identity proof. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. SC/ST/SEBC certificate, where applicable. PwD certificate or UDID card, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen discharge and service documents, where applicable. Sports qualification certificate, if claiming the applicable reservation. Appointment letters and relevant employment documents for eligible contractual Ophthalmic Assistants claiming the notified age relaxation. Other documents prescribed by the commission during verification. The photograph must be clear and recent. Candidates should keep the same photograph available throughout the recruitment process. The exact upload requirements displayed on the official application portal must be followed.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer District Preference and Posting 2026
content_sections.text: Ophthalmic Officer is a District Cadre post . Candidates are recruited for district establishments under the Health & Family Welfare Department. The commission will consider the district preference, merit position, applicable reservation and vacancies during the final allocation process. The commission may notify an option to revise or re-exercise district preferences before the allotment stage. If a candidate does not use the available revision facility, the district preferences already submitted may be treated as final. Candidates should monitor official recruitment notices and meet any specified preference-revision deadlines.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: After the written examination, OSSSC will prepare a provisional merit list and shortlist eligible candidates for document verification. The commission may shortlist candidates for verification based on the number of vacancies and the applicable category-wise requirements, including a minimum shortlisting ratio of 1.25 times the notified category-wise vacancies where applicable. Original qualification, council registration, age, language and reservation certificates must be produced before the competent verification authority. Important: Provisional inclusion in the merit list does not guarantee appointment. Any discrepancy between the online application and original documents may lead to rejection.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: OSSSC will announce the written examination date and admit card availability through its official website. Eligible candidates must download their admission letter using the designated applicant login or admission-letter facility. The commission will not send admission letters by post. Applicants should regularly check official notices, their registered mobile number and their email account.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) under the Health & Family Welfare Department of the Government of Odisha for filling various departmental vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced for the Ophthalmic Officer post?
faq.answer: A total of 238 vacancies have been announced for the Ophthalmic Officer position under advertisement number No.IIE-103/2026-3226/OSSSC across various district establishments in the state of Odisha.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start for OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The online registration and submission of applications for the Ophthalmic Officer recruitment officially start on 5 November 2026, allowing eligible candidates to begin their online submission process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The final deadline to submit the online application form for the Ophthalmic Officer post is 5 December 2026, while the online registration/re-registration closes earlier on 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the official website to apply for OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates must visit the official OSSSC web portal at www.osssc.gov.in to complete their online registration and submit their application forms securely.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Ophthalmic Officer posts must be submitted exclusively through the online mode via the official OSSSC web portal. No other mode of application will be accepted by the commission.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job location for selected candidates under this notification?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed across 29 district establishments operating under the Health & Family Welfare Department of the Government of Odisha according to departmental requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for the OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee details for applicants. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification on the official website for any specific updates.

faq.question: Q9. Who should candidates contact or where is the office located for OSSSC?
faq.answer: The headquarters of the Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission is located at Block No.-3 & 5, Unit-1, Bhubaneswar-751009. Candidates can check official notices there or online.
